items.title: Cripple a Scorched's Leg
items.detail: Fast travel to Morgantown Airport and aim at the leg with a rifle, using V.A.T.S. for easier targeting.

items.title: Catch a Fish in the Cranberry Bog Region
items.detail: Fast travel to Quarry X3 in Cranberry Bog, walk to the large lake, equip a fishing rod and cast.

items.title: Consume an Alcoholic Beverage
items.detail: Get an alcoholic beverage from a C.A.M.P. Brewing Vat or another player's C.A.M.P., then consume it.

items.title: Craft Fish Bits
items.detail: Craft at a Cooking Station by processing caught fish; small yield 1, medium yield 2, large yield 5, Axolotl yield 25.

items.title: Gain XP
items.detail: Gain XP through normal gameplay; West Tek is a fast grind option for super mutants.

items.title: Kill a Yao Guai
items.detail: Fast travel to High Knob Lookout for a reliable spawn; use V.A.T.S. targeting the head as weak spot.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Shovel during the "Disturbed Grave" Quest while on a Team
items.detail: Join a team, start the Disturbed Grave quest, equip a shovel and kill enemies; low-level insects like Fireflies are easy targets.

items.title: Build a Floor, Wall, or Roof in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Enter build menu and construct basic wood or concrete floors, then scrap them for credit.

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source deep enough; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is reliable.

items.title: Complete an Infestation
items.detail: Find the large gray cloudy area on map, fast travel to location inside it, locate the red hotspot and complete the event.

items.title: Craft Fish Bits
items.detail: Process caught fish at a Cooking Station; varying yields based on fish size and type.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for reliable robot spawns; use energy weapons and V.A.T.S. for efficiency.

items.title: Eat Pre-war Food
items.detail: Consume any pre-war food like BlamCo Mac and Cheese, Dandy Boy Apples, or Pork n' Beans.

items.title: Kill a Floater
items.detail: Fast travel to Solomon's Pond for reliable spawn; target the eyes with V.A.T.S. as weak spot.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Find active Infestation on map, locate the red hotspot, and kill Pint-Sized Phantoms within the encounter.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete a Mischief Night event, stay in the Vertibot area of the final stage where the Phantom can spawn.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Community contest to build slasher-themed C.A.M.P.s with finalists receiving atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal event featuring Pint-Sized Phantoms and exclusive Slasher rewards.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Double mutation chance applies to Daily Ops and rewards during this bonus period.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Scorched enemies appear with seasonal spooky variants and exclusive rewards.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Earn double experience points from all activities during this weekend bonus.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chances to catch seasonal fish during this special weekend event.
